chain.title: The Hut in the Orchid Swamp
chain.desc: Terralith's rebuilt swamp hut generates in Orchid Swamp, Ice Marsh and vanilla swamp; its chest holds potions, a splash potion, a golden apple and a tadpole bucket.

chain.title: Shelter in the Chasm
chain.desc: A small ruin that generates only in the Glacial Chasm biome. Its main chest carries stone and wooden tools, leather armour and food - a survival cache, not treasure.

chain.title: Under the Cherry Snow
chain.desc: Terralith's own igloo generates in the Snowy Cherry Grove. Its chest is stocked with emeralds, lapis, amethyst shards, a writable book and cherry logs and saplings.

chain.title: The Lodge in the Clearing
chain.desc: A hunting lodge that only appears in Valley Clearing and Shield Clearing. Its lodge_drinkables chest holds potions, suspicious stew, honey bottles, bowls and bottles.

chain.title: Pillagers in the Sand
chain.desc: A desert outpost with a pillager spawn override. Its chest can hold a crossbow, arrows, a goat horn and both the Dune and Sentry armour trim smithing templates.

chain.title: A Cabin Beneath the Lush Caves
chain.desc: A buried cabin in the Lush Caves. Its underground chest table runs from raw copper and clay up to diamond ore, a diamond helmet and a diamond pickaxe.

chain.title: The Camp in Deep Caves
chain.desc: An abandoned mining camp that generates only in Terralith's Deep Caves biome, stocked from the same underground chest table of iron, gold and diamond gear.

chain.title: The Refinery That Stopped
chain.desc: A derelict refinery in the Fungal Caves, Infested Caves and Deep Caves biomes, carrying the underground chest loot.

chain.title: The Tower That Sank
chain.desc: A tower swallowed by the Lush Caves and Underground Jungle, still holding an underground chest.

chain.title: Frostfire Dungeon
chain.desc: A dungeon buried in the Frostfire Caves biome; the only Terralith structure that generates there, and it keeps an underground chest.

chain.title: The Hive Below
chain.desc: A giant hive in Lush Caves and Underground Jungle. Its chest gives honeycomb and honey bottles and rolls the royal_jelly table, which is a potion.

chain.title: Walls Around the Plains
chain.desc: A walled village for Plains, Meadow, Temperate/Forested/Alpine Highlands and Brushland, with twelve loot tables including a treasure chest that can drop an enchanted golden apple.

chain.title: Walls Around the Oasis
chain.desc: The desert counterpart, generating in Desert, Desert Oasis and Lush Desert with its own twelve-table village loot set.

chain.title: The Mage's Tower
chain.desc: A lone tower in Moonlight Valley, Lavender Valley, Amethyst Canyon and Mirage Isles. Its mage treasure chest holds diamonds and rolls the mage extras table.

chain.title: The Order's Compound
chain.desc: The full mage complex, restricted to Moonlight Grove, Lavender Forest and Amethyst Rainforest. Three tables: barracks, extras and treasure.

chain.title: A Tower in the Skylands
chain.desc: One of four seasonal mage towers that generate only on the floating Skylands. This one is bound to Skylands Winter and carries the mage treasure chest.

chain.title: The Spire on Frozen Water
chain.desc: Terralith's rarest build, generating only on Frozen River. Four chest tables; the treasure roll can yield a trident and a full set of diamond tools.

notes: TERRALITH ADDS NO ITEMS AT ALL. This is a verified finding, not a gap: the jar contains ZERO assets/ entries - no assets/terralith/models/item/, no blockstates, no lang file, nothing. It is a datapack shipped in a jar, with data/ only. item_count_in_jar is therefore 0 and collections is empty; there is nothing to build a wheel out of. LOADER: META-INF/mods.toml and META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml both present (modId terralith, version 2.5.4, minecraft [1.20,1.21)), plus a fabric.mod.json - it is a multiloader datapack jar and the Modrinth 1.20.1 Forge listing resolves to this exact file. CONTENT: 99 biomes at data/terralith/worldgen/biome/*.json and 28 structures at data/terralith/worldgen/structure/*.json. STRUCTURE->LOOT was resolved mechanically, not guessed: each structure json's resource ids were followed through data/terralith/worldgen/template_pool/ transitively, every referenced data/terralith/structures/*.nbt was gunzipped, and the id-like strings inside the raw NBT were intersected with the jar's 51 real loot_tables/*.json. 22 of the 28 structures resolve to at least one chest loot table. THE 6 WITH NO LOOT ARE ALL EXCLUDED from the chain: rubble_desert, rubble_forest, rubble_jungle, rubble_mesa, rubble_mountain and rubble_taiga are decorative surface ruins with zero chest tables - exactly the 'purely decorative scenery' case, so they are not quested. ALSO EXCLUDED: terralith:underground/witch_hut, which does resolve loot but whose biomes field is #terralith:has_structure/none, and that tag file is literally {"replace": false, "values": []} - it can never generate, so questing it would be unwinnable. The three unused seasonal mage towers (mage_tower_autumn, mage_tower_spring, mage_tower_summer) are real and loot-bearing but are the same build as mage_tower_winter in a different Skylands season, so only one representative is used. Loot contents quoted above were read out of the loot table json, not inferred from the name: spire/treasure lists minecraft:trident plus diamond sword/axe/pickaxe/shovel and full diamond armour; desert_outpost lists dune_armor_trim_smithing_template and sentry_armor_trim_smithing_template; village/fortified/treasure lists enchanted_golden_apple; underground/giant_bee_hive rolls TABLE terralith:royal_jelly, which is a minecraft:potion. Biome placements come from each structure's biomes field resolved through data/terralith/tags/worldgen/biome/has_structure/*.json. ID FORM: every chain entry is 'structure:' + a fully namespaced id, and every one of those ids is a file that exists at data/terralith/worldgen/structure/<path>.json in this jar (the two nested ones keep their folder, e.g. terralith:underground/mining_outpost). The 'structure:' prefix mirrors the existing kill: and dim: prefixes and maps to the generator's {"type":"structure","structure":"<id>"} task; the loader in autoquestgen.py currently only strips kill:/dim:, so it needs the same three-line branch for structure: before these entries reach the book. No template_pool, start_pool, structure_set or processor names appear as chain ids.
